observed_issue: The changes and approved decisions could not be selected, resolve/reopen/delete note actions had no visible effect, and submitting a new note refreshed the page.
root_cause: Two independent migration defects were present. First, the handlers mutated nested objects returned by the selectedAsset computed value directly. Those plain-object mutations bypassed San data updates, so selectedAsset, visibleNotes, decisionText, classes, and the note list were not recomputed. Second, Vue's @submit.prevent modifier was translated to on-submit without preserving preventDefault behavior, so the browser performed a native form submission and refreshed the page when a note was added.
fix: Decision, note resolution, note deletion, and note addition now create new asset/note objects and write the complete next assets array through this.data.set('assets', nextAssets). The note form passes $event to addNote(event), which calls preventDefault() before updating state.
manual_checks: Note add, filter, jump-to-time, resolve, and delete interactions.
expected_after_fix: Decision text and chosen styles should update; resolving/reopening should update note state and filtering; deleting should remove the note immediately; adding should append a reactive note without navigating or refreshing the page.
